name: Aizawa Attractor
recipe: The Aizawa attractor: a 3D chaotic system iterated and projected to 2D forms a mesmerizing spherical shell wrapped with a spiral tube through its poles — a glowing cosmic ornament. Slowly rotate the 3D projection on K.t so it turns, and drift a parameter so the shell morphs. Default COLORFUL: point density + depth log-mapped through an iq palette (indigo shell -> gold spiral) glowing on dark, luminance ~0.12-0.35.
kernel: iterate the Aizawa ODE (a,b,c,d,e,f) ~30-60k steps/frame; rotate (x,y,z) by a K.t-driven 3D rotation, project to 2D, splat into a coarse density buffer shaded by z-depth; log-map through palette LUT, upscale. Continuous rotation = motion.
style: cosmic (default, indigo shell/gold spiral). Also: plasma (magenta/cyan), ember (blackbody), ice (blue/white), pencil (named mono).

name: Ulam Prime Spiral
recipe: The Ulam spiral: integers spiral out from the center and PRIMES are marked, revealing the eerie diagonal lines where primes cluster. The spiral progressively fills/grows on K.t and a scanning highlight sweeps the diagonals; periodically restart with a different offset/polynomial. Default COLORFUL: prime dots glowing (hue by residue class or by diagonal) on a dark grid, faint composite dots, luminance ~0.15-0.4, fills frame.
kernel: precompute a prime sieve in S once; map each integer to its Ulam-spiral (x,y); each frame draw primes up to a growing count N (grows on K.t) as glowing dots (hue by n mod k or diagonal family), faint composites; a sweep line highlights. Restart offset on K.section. Growing fill = motion.
style: prime-glow (default, residue-hued primes on dark). Also: phosphor (green), gold-on-black, thermal (by magnitude), blueprint (white on blue).

name: Collatz River
recipe: Collatz (3n+1) orbits rendered as a growing organic tree/river: each number's hailstone path is a curved strand that bends one way on even steps, the other on odd, so thousands of paths braid into a coral/river-delta tree. New strands stream in on K.t; the delta perpetually thickens then resets. Default COLORFUL: strands hued by orbit length or depth (violet young -> gold old) glowing on dark, luminance ~0.15-0.4, fills frame.
kernel: for many seed integers, walk the Collatz sequence turning the drawing heading by a fixed +/- angle per even/odd step, tracing a smooth strand from a common root; accumulate strands into a persistent buffer with age-color; add more/re-root on K.t/section. Growing braid = motion.
style: delta (default, violet->gold strands on dark). Also: coral (teal/pink), autumn, bioluminescent, ink (named mono, black strands on cream).

name: Gosper Flowsnake
recipe: The Gosper curve (flowsnake): a hexagonal space-filling L-system fractal whose single continuous path fills a snowflake-like region, self-similar at every scale. It draws itself progressively and morphs iteration depth on K.t, the whole figure slowly rotating. Distinct from Hilbert (square) — this is the hex flowsnake. Default COLORFUL: hue-gradient along the path length (spectral) with soft glow on dark, luminance ~0.18-0.45, fills frame.
kernel: generate the Gosper L-system vertex list to depth D (cache per depth); each frame draw a growing prefix of the path (progressive reveal on K.t) as a hue-gradient glowing polyline; rotate slowly; step depth on K.section. Rebuild cache on depth change.
style: spectral-snake (default, hue-along-length glow). Also: neon, gold-leaf, blueprint (white on blue), ink (named mono).

name: Quantum Wavefunction
recipe: A 2D Schrodinger wavefunction: a complex field evolves, its probability density |psi|^2 rippling into interference fringes, self-focusing lumps and spreading packets, while the phase spins — quantum-mechanical flow. Colour by phase (hue) modulated by |psi|^2 (brightness) so you see both amplitude and phase. Default COLORFUL: phase->full hue wheel, |psi|^2->brightness, on dark; luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: coarse complex field (re,im) in S (<=140 wide); each frame do a few split-step / finite-difference Schrodinger updates in a gentle potential (evolves on K.t); render hue=atan2(im,re), value=|psi|^2 (normalized) into pixels[] buffer, upscale. Re-inject a packet on K.section. Intrinsic evolution = motion.
style: phase-density (default, phase-hue x |psi|^2). Also: thermal (density only), interference (blue/white fringes), spectral, mono (named, density greyscale).

name: Additive Waveform
recipe: Additive synthesis made visible: a stack of pure sine harmonics (each drawn faintly) sums into one bold composite waveform that morphs as harmonic amplitudes/phases drift on K.t — an oscilloscope of Fourier synthesis, sawtooth<->square<->organic. Mirror/stack a few oscilloscope lanes to fill the frame. Default COLORFUL: harmonics in a spectral gradient (low=red -> high=violet), the sum bright white/gold, on dark; luminance ~0.15-0.4, edge-to-edge.
kernel: compute N harmonic sines with drifting amplitudes/phases (K.t); draw each faint harmonic + the bright summed waveform as glowing polylines across the width; stack 2-4 vertically-offset lanes with phase offsets to fill the frame. Audio A.fft can modulate amplitudes on top.
style: spectral-scope (default, harmonic gradient + gold sum). Also: phosphor (green CRT), amber-crt, neon, blueprint (white on blue).

name: Rauzy Fractal Tiling
recipe: The Rauzy fractal: the self-similar aperiodic tiling arising from the Tribonacci substitution, a jagged three-lobed fractal region tiled by three colored copies of itself — a strange-beautiful quasi-crystalline mosaic. Slowly rotate/re-color and step the substitution depth on K.t so the mosaic breathes. Default COLORFUL: the three sub-tiles in three rich hues (magenta/teal/gold) with fractal boundaries, luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: generate Rauzy fractal points via the Tribonacci substitution / projection (cache to depth D in S); render the three residue-classes as three colored point-clouds / filled regions; slow rotation + hue drift on K.t, depth step on K.section. Fills frame.
style: tri-jewel (default, magenta/teal/gold lobes). Also: pastel, thermal, neon-edge (boundaries), ink (named mono, three greys).

name: Mobius Transform
recipe: A Mobius (conformal) transformation continuously warps a colored grid/checkerboard on the complex plane: straight lines bend into circles, the whole plane swirls through elliptic/loxodromic flows toward and away from two fixed points — endlessly morphing conformal distortion. Default COLORFUL: a bright checker/polar grid pushed through the Mobius map, hue rotating on K.t; luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: per-pixel (coarse buffer): treat (x,y) as complex z, apply the inverse Mobius map w=(az+b)/(cz+d) with parameters flowing on K.t (loxodromic: multiply by e^{(s+it)} between two fixed points), sample a synthetic grid/checker/polar source at w through a palette. Continuous flow = motion.
style: checker-flow (default, warped checker, hue drift). Also: polar-grid, neon-lattice, oil-slick, mono-op (named).

name: Complex Domain Coloring
recipe: Domain coloring of a complex function: each pixel z is colored by f(z) — HUE from the argument (phase) and brightness/contour-rings from the modulus — revealing the poles, zeros and branch cuts of rational/elliptic functions as glowing rosettes. The function's parameters (pole/zero positions, exponents) drift on K.t so the phase portrait swirls and reconfigures. Default COLORFUL: full phase-wheel hue with modulus contour shading, luminance ~0.25-0.55, fills frame.
kernel: per-pixel (coarse buffer): z=complex(pixel), evaluate a parametric f(z) (e.g. product of (z-zero_i)/(z-pole_i) with drifting positions, or z^n+c), colour hue=arg(f), value shaded by fract(log|f|) for contour rings + overall |f| level. Poles/zeros drift on K.t. Continuous swirl = motion.
style: phase-portrait (default, phase-wheel + modulus rings). Also: thermal, ink-contour (named mono, level lines), neon, pastel.

name: Spirograph Roulettes
recipe: FIX of a version that was too FAINT/sparse (a few thin lines in dead space, lum 0.096). Re-author DENSE and BRIGHT: layer 4-7 hypotrochoid/epitrochoid roulettes with MANY windings each (long t-range so each traces a full dense rosette of hundreds of loops), thick two-pass additive glow, vivid per-pen hues, filling ~80% of the frame with luminous interlocking moire flowers. Ratios drift on K.t so they bloom/re-pattern. Default COLORFUL: multi-hue glowing rosettes on dark; luminance ~0.2-0.45.
kernel: draw 4-7 hypotrochoid curves x=(R-r)cos t + d cos((R-r)/r t) over a LONG t-range (many windings, ratios chosen so it doesn't close too soon) as dense polylines with wide dim ADD glow + bright core; each pen a different R/r/d/hue/center; ratios drift slowly on K.t. Fill the frame, keep it bright.
style: neon-rosette (default, dense multi-hue glow). Also: gold-guilloche (metallic), pastel-spiro, blueprint (white on blue), ink (named mono).
